result.analyst_notes: Confident, aspirational tone with absolute phrasing ('takes on the toughest health challenges'). Leads with science, patients and innovation; employees and safety are barely addressed. Mostly third-person 'we' corporate voice. Ethics section is formulaic, with a structured list of program elements but no measurable commitments. Commitments are largely unhedged.
